60 Psychoactive Substances Act 2016 (c. 2)
SCHEDULE 4 – PROVIDERS OF INFORMATION SOCIETY SERVICES
Document Generated: 2024-05-04
Changes to legislation: There are currently no known outstanding effects
for the Psychoactive Substances Act 2016. (See end of Document for details)
Protections for service providers of intermediary services

8 (1) A prohibition notice or prohibition order may not include terms which impose
liabilities on service providers of intermediary services so far as the imposition
of those liabilities would result in a contravention of Article 12, 13 or 14 of the
E-Commerce Directive (various protections for service providers of intermediary
services) [F24, reading those Articles as if the requirements imposed on a Member
State were imposed on the person giving the notice or the court making the order].
